# Embedded Emissions: Cannot Compute

I can't determine a definitive embedded emissions figure from the data provided, so I won't estimate one.

## Missing Input

**(a) CN code of the good.** The scenario describes the good only as "a steel product." The ruleset selects the default SEE jointly by CN code and country, so without a specific CN code there is no single SEE to apply.

The factor table lists several iron and steel CN codes with different default SEE values for China:

| CN code | Good | Default SEE, China (tCO2e/t) |
|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen | 1.66 |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots of iron and non-alloy steel | 1.74 |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products of iron or non-alloy steel | 3.314 |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods of iron or non-alloy steel, with indentations | 3.169 |

"Steel product" could correspond to several of these, and each would give a materially different result.

## Inputs Already Provided

- **(b) Country of production:** China, which is listed for all CN codes in the table.
- **(c) Quantity:** 500 tonnes.

## To Proceed

Please provide the CN code of the good. If it matches one of the codes in the table, I will calculate the total as SEE (China) × 500 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.
